description: Open-source, AI-native PDF reviewer for iPad and the browser: highlight, comment, record voice notes and suggest rewordings on a PDF without editing it. Static web app, local-first, with opt-in speech-to-text and transcript polish through the user's own provider keys.
rules: VoxNote is a static web app at https://estcarisimo.github.io/voxnote/ with no backend and no accounts. PDFs, annotations and recordings stay in the browser's IndexedDB, keyed by the document's SHA-256.
The PDF is never modified in place. Export PDF writes a copy with native annotations; the Markdown and JSON exports contain no audio.

Transcription and polish are opt-in and need the user's own API key: OpenAI, Deepgram or Groq for speech-to-text; OpenAI, Anthropic or xAI for polish. Nothing is sent before the user taps Send in the consent dialog, which names the host and what is sent.
The raw transcript is always preserved. Polish proposes a cleaned text next to the raw one, and only Accept changes the note body.
No accuracy or latency figures exist for any provider; do not quote any. Whether Deepgram and Groq accept calls straight from a browser is unverified.
Run from source with npm ci and npm run dev (Node 24 in CI). Production builds and npm run preview are served under the /voxnote/ path.
